name: Blocky Terrain Meshing with Precomputed Culling
definition: A meshing technique for blocky terrains that avoids full Constructive Solid Geometry (CSG) on every possible combination of sides by using a matrix of precomputed bitmasks to determine if a face covers another, enabling fast culling.
summary: Blocky Terrain Meshing with Precomputed Culling optimizes mesh generation for blocky terrains by using precomputed bitmasks to determine face occlusion, avoiding full Constructive Solid Geometry computations at runtime.
